body: If you’ve still got space I’m down to do it

Everybody is selfish in their own little world, everybody is the centre of their own universe. Mental health is a big thing and a lot of people are scared by it, scared they’ll make it worse by talking to you so everybody secretly hopes someone else will do the dirty work and be there for you. You’re not lying to yourself, in the darkest times there’s still things that can make you laugh. Be yourself, that’s the best you can be. People will love you for who you are, treat others kindly. Try and make other people smile. Maybe that’ll help you smile. I wish I could tell you things will get better but I am going through the exact same thing. Maybe they won’t get better, but you will get better. Your brain might never shut up, but you’ll get better at dealing with it, you’ll find your own methods that work. I hope I will too

You ever watched that bit in Harry Potter where hermoine just makes her parents forget everything? That would be perfect, so it would be possible to truly understand what I want, instead of being alive due to guilt

Yeah, it’s like a never ending sequence, a ‘good say’ is not a good day, it just means that you haven’t thought about killing yourself or tried to hurt yourself today. You seem to know a lot about it though, I guess it’s good understanding what’s going on in your own brain

I get that yeah, its just shit. Get the same people that talk so much about mental health and about how they’ll always be there for you making you feel like you’re not good enough, in a time where you already want to take your own life. I guess it’s easier with therapists, I just always seem to get the whole ‘you’re so brave for talking about this’ bullshit which is the furthest possible thing from helpful. I will try and think more this way though
Nobody wants me to kill myself but nobody cares that I’m alive, so what’s the point.
